claims.text: Albendazole (neurocysticercosis, hydatid disease): 60 kg or more, 400 mg twice daily; under 60 kg, 15 mg/kg/day in two doses (max 800 mg/day), with food.
claims.quote: Patients weighing 60 kg or greater, 400 mg twice daily; less than 60 kg, 15 mg/kg/day in divided doses twice daily (maximum total daily dose 800 mg). ALBENZA tablets should be taken with food.

claims.text: Neurocysticercosis: give steroids and anticonvulsants as needed; consider corticosteroids to prevent cerebral hypertensive episodes in the first week.
claims.quote: Patients being treated for neurocysticercosis should receive appropriate steroid and anticonvulsant therapy as required. Oral or intravenous corticosteroids should be considered to prevent cerebral hypertensive episodes during the first week of treatment

claims.text: Albendazole: check blood counts at the start of each 28-day cycle and every 2 weeks during therapy;
claims.quote: Monitor blood counts at the beginning of each 28-day cycle of therapy, and every 2 weeks while on therapy

claims.text: check liver enzymes at the start of each cycle and at least every 2 weeks.
claims.quote: Monitor liver enzymes (transaminases) at the beginning of each 28-day cycle of therapy, and at least every 2 weeks during treatment

claims.text: Get a pregnancy test before therapy in women of reproductive potential.
claims.quote: Obtain a pregnancy test in women of reproductive potential prior to therapy
